name: Cnki Advanced Search
summary: Perform advanced search on CNKI with field filters like author, title, journal, date range, source category (SCI/EI/CSSCI/北大核心). Use when user needs precise filtered search beyond simple keywords.

name: Cnki Download
summary: Download a paper PDF/CAJ from CNKI. Requires user to be logged in. Use when user wants to download a specific paper.

name: Cnki Journal Index
summary: Query journal indexing/inclusion status on CNKI - check which databases include a journal (北大核心, CSSCI, CSCD, SCI, EI, etc.), get impact factors and evaluation data. Use when user asks about a journal's level, indexing, or ranking.

name: Cnki Journal Search
summary: Search for journals/publications on CNKI by name, ISSN, CN, or sponsor. Use when the user wants to find a specific journal or browse publications.

name: Cnki Paper Detail
summary: Extract full paper details from a CNKI paper page including title, authors, affiliations, abstract, keywords, fund, classification. Use when the user needs detailed information about a specific paper.

name: Cnki Search
summary: Search CNKI (中国知网) for papers by keyword. Use when the user wants to find academic papers on a topic.

name: Gs Search
summary: Search Google Scholar for academic papers by keywords. Returns results with title, authors, journal, year, citation count, and full-text links. Use when the user wants to search Google Scholar.
